signatureKind: custom Ed25519 publisherSignature field in beta-linux.yml; not OS code signing
keyGeneration: Owner supplied public key after local generation. Do not generate a replacement key.

custody.privateKey: Keep the encrypted PKCS8 private key owner-only, mode 0600, under an owner-only directory.
custody.backup: Keep a separately recoverable encrypted private-key backup; keep the passphrase separately and verify recovery locally.
custody.secretAccess: The release tool reads a local explicit --key path and protected passphrase FD only; it has no secret-manager integration.

signerMapping.passphrase: Explicit --passphrase-fd >=3, read from local owner prompt. Existing passphrase storage labels are not inputs this signer reads; no Doppler/environment adapter exists.

ownerSteps: Copy the existing encrypted private.pem to owner-selected separate backup storage; keep the passphrase separately and verify recovery locally. Do not overwrite it or generate another key.
When the final AppImage and unsigned manifest exist, sign locally with private.pem, entering the passphrase only at the terminal prompt.
Verify the signature against the pinned public key and exact final AppImage before metadata publication.
Keep updater inactive until genuine signed bootstrap/download/install/restart/rollback acceptance and explicit activation decision.
evidenceBoundary: Synthetic signatures made with public test keys prove verifier behavior only. They do not prove signing with the owner key, private-key recoverability or real update acceptance.
manualOnlyConditions: activated:false causes zero updater backend/network calls. Manual publication still requires exact artifact/source/checksum/license verification and truthful acceptance limits.
ownerLocalSigningHelper: bash scripts/sign-owner-release.sh /absolute/final.AppImage /absolute/unsigned-beta.json /absolute/beta-linux.yml; helper prompts locally, verifies the fixed public pin and exact AppImage, and refuses to overwrite the output.
